hook: You've heard Russia is bigger than Pluto. It isn't.

beats.narration: You've heard Russia is bigger than Pluto. It isn't.
Russia covers about seventeen point one million square kilometres.
beats.claim: Russia's total area is about 17.1 million km².

beats.narration: Older estimates put Pluto's surface lower, around sixteen point six million. So the fact stuck.
beats.claim: Before New Horizons, Pluto's surface area was estimated at about 16.6 million km².

beats.narration: Then in twenty fifteen, NASA's New Horizons flew past Pluto and measured it properly.
beats.claim: NASA's New Horizons mission corrected the estimate of Pluto's size.

beats.narration: New number: about seventeen point seven million square kilometres.
beats.claim: Pluto's surface area is about 17.74 million km².

beats.narration: Pluto wins by over six hundred thousand square kilometres. That's more than all of Spain.
beats.claim: 17.74M minus 17.10M is about 0.64M km²; Spain is about 0.5M km².

beats.narration: But Russia is still wider. About nine thousand kilometres east to west. Pluto is only two thousand three hundred and seventy seven across.
beats.claim: Russia spans about 9,000 km east to west; Pluto is about 2,377 km across.

beats.narration: Wider country. Bigger dwarf planet. Almost a tie.

title: Russia is NOT bigger than Pluto
description: The famous fact was true with old estimates. Then New Horizons measured Pluto in 2015.
